primaryText:
Product Specifications

Product No.

SST-ST75F-GS

Color

Black (lead-free paint)

Max. DC Output

750W

Power density

415W per liter

Load Range

| Output | +3.3V | +5V | +12V | +5VSB | -12V |
| --- |
| Max.(Amps) | 20A | 20A | 62A | 2.5A | 0.3A |
| Min.(Amps) | 0A | 0A | 0A | 0A | 0A |
| Range (%) | ±3% | ±3% | ±3% | ±5% | ±10% |
| Line Reg.(%) | ±1% | ±1% | ±1% | ±1% | ±1% |
| Ripple(mVp-p) | 50mV | 50mV | 120mV | 50mV | 120mV |

Combined +3.3V & +5V

100W

Combined +12V

744W

Input Voltage

90V~264V

Input Frequency Range

47Hz ~ 63Hz

PFC

Active PFC.（PF>0.9 at Full Load）

Efficiency

87%~90% at 20%~100% loading

MTBF

100,000 hours

Operating temperature

0°C ~ 40°C

Protection

Over power protection  
  
Over current protection  
  
Over voltage protection  
  
Over temperature protection  
  
Under voltage protection  
  
Short circuit protection

Connectors

1 x 24 / 20-Pin motherboard connector（600mm）  
  
2 x 8 / 4-Pin EPS / ATX 12V connector（"750mm" x 2）  
  
4 x 8/6-Pin PCIE connector（"550mm"）  
  
8 x SATA connector（"600mm /150mm / 150mm / 150mm" x 2）  
  
6 x 4-Pin Peripheral connector（”600mm / 150mm / 150mm” x 2）   
  
2 x 4-Pin Floppy connector（150mm）

Cooling System

Single 120mm silent fan

Noise Level

18 dBA minimum

Certification

80 PLUS Gold

Form factor

ATX

Dimension

150 mm (W) x 86 mm (H) x 140 mm (D)

Weight

1.31 kg

Other

[GPU Support list](https://www.silverstonetek.com/downloads/PSU/GPU-supportlist.pdf)

 ● ST75F-GS(V3.0) is 100% modular cable design power supply, and the 24 pin connector design is 18+10pin to 24pin (20+4) +4 pin. Therefore, the PP05-E and PP06 24pin cables can’t be used in ST75F-GS(V3.0).  
 ● ST75F-GS (V3.1) improves compatibility with certain system configurations.  
● Specifications presented on this page contains most recent revisions and may differ from those printed on retail boxes or manuals.
